title: Health Resort west wing room 203 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 203 of the West wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort west wing room 203 key (W203 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium west wing room 203.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Connected to room 205 through the balcony.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: - In the house closest to the bus stop in the Village. Walk through the door and it's on the chair beneath the Jackets. There is a spawn point just on the other side of the fence.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor, room 203 of the West Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Room 203:
  - Red keycard spawn location
  - LEDX spawn
  - 1× Weapon spawn (AR)
  - 1× Medbag
  - 1× Medcase
  - 1× Weapon box (6x2)
  - 1× Toolbox
  - 1× Sport bag
  - Loose loot (Meds, Medical supplies, Currency)
- Room 205:
  - 1× LEDX spawn
  - 1× Graphics Card spawn
  - 1× Toolbox
  - 1× Medcase
  - Loose loot (Meds, Medical supplies, Provisions).
